opener_concept: Ladybird in a photo: 5 mm real vs 60 mm on screen. 'How many times bigger?' (60/5 = 12) IS magnification = image / actual, a unitless ratio; second box does image = actual x magnification. Reveal names the same-unit rule as the whole skill.
